30% : $670/2 SUPPLEMENTALZONINGLOTandLARGESCALEDEVELOPMENT AGREEMENT , s  a   p     made as of the 2day of August, 2015 between 50 RIVERSIDE BLVD LLC, a Delaware limited liability company ("Parcel K-1 Owner"), having an office c/o The Carlyle Group, 520 Madison Avenue, New York, New York 10022 and 301 FREEDOM PLACE SOUTH, LLC, a New York limited liability company, having an office at 260 West 78"h Street, New York, New York 10024 ("ParcelK-2Owner"). WITNESSETH WHEREAS, Parcel K-1 Owner is the owner in fee simple of certain land located in the Borough of Manhattan, City, County and State of New York which land is designated as Tax Lot 150 on Block 1171 on the Tax Map of The City of New York ("Parcel K-1 Owner's Land") and being more particularly described in Exhibit_A-1 attached hereto, together with the improvements now Oor hereafter located on Parcel K-1 Owner's Land ("Parcel K-1 Owner's Improvements ") (Parcel K-1 Owner's Land and Parcel K-1 Owner's Improvements are herein collectively called the "Parcel K-1 Owner's Property"). WHEREAS, Parcel K-2 Owner is the owner in fee simple of certain land located in the Borough of Manhattan, City, County and State of New York which land is designated as Tax Lot 151 in Block 1171 on the Tax Map of The City of New York ("Parcel K-2 Owner's Land") and being more particularly described in Exhibit A-2 attached hereto, together with the improvements now or hereafter located on the Parcel K-2 Owner Land ("Parcel K-2 Owner's Improvements") (Parcel K-2 Owner's Land and Parcel K-2 Owner's Improvements are herein collectively called "Parcel K-2 Owner's Property"). parcels of land are part of a General Large-Scale Development (the "Riverside South GLSD") which obtained special permits pursuant to Sections 74-52, 74-681 and 74-743 of the Zoning Resolution of the City of New York as in effect at such time and a certification pursuant to Section 26-07) of the Zoning Resolution of the City of New York as in effect at such time under ULURP No. C 920358 ZSM, which were approved by the New York City Planning Commission (the "Commission") on October 26, 1992 and by the New York City Council (the "Council") on December 17, 1992 (the "Original Special Permits"). WHEREAS, Parcel K-1 Owner's Property is designated in the Riverside South GLSD as Parcel K-1 and Parcel K-2 Owner's Property is designated as Parcel K-2 and Parcel K-1 and Parcel K-2 are designated collectively as Parcel K. WHEREAS, the Original Special Permits were modified by the Commission on December 16, 1996 pursuant to ULURP No. C 920358(A) ZSM, on August 2, 1999 pursuant to ULURP No. C 920358(B) ZSM, on April 1, 2002 pursuant to ULURP No. C 920358(C) ZSM and on October 27, 2010 pursuant to ULURP No. C 920358(D) ZSM (the Original Riverside South Special Permits, as modified, the“RiversideSouth Special Permits"). 107/24/2015 6:00 PM NY245323866v2

WHEREAS, in connection with the Riverside South Special Permits, a Restrictive Declaration ("Riverside South Declaration") was executed by Penn Yards Associates dated as of December 17, 1992 and recorded in the Office of the City Register, New York County (the “City Register") on January 6, 1993 in Reel 1934, Page 1. WHEREAS, the Riverside South Declaration was modified by the First Modification to the Restrictive Declaration (the “First Modification") made as of October 4, 1994 and recorded in the Office of the City Register on December 2, 1994 in Reel 2159, Page 1096; by a Second Modification to the Restrictive Declaration (the “Second Modification") made as of January 9, 1997 and recorded in the Office of the City Register on February 13, 1997 in Reel 2422, Page 424; by a Third Modification to the Restrictive Declaration (the “Third Modification") made as of September 13, 1999 and recorded in the Office of the City Register on January 7, 2000 in Reel 3026, Page 1983; by a Fourth Modification to the Restrictive Declaration made as of November 9, 2001 and recorded in the Office of the City Register on January 25, 2002 in Reel 3436, Page 1992, as restated by Restated Fourth Modification to the Restrictive Declaration made as of November 9, 2001 and recorded in Modification"); by a Fifth Modification to the Restrictive Declaration (the “Fifth Modification made as of September 1, 2011 and recorded in the Office of the City Register on December 14, 2011 under CRFN Number 2011000434593; by a Sixth Modification to the Restrictive Declaration (the “Sixth Modification") made as of June 12, 2014 and recorded in the Office of the City Modification to the Restrictive Declaration (the “Seventh Modification") made as of June 12, 2014 P              n  2015000144278 (the Riverside South Declaration, as amended by the First Modification, the Second Modification, the Third Modification, the Fourth Modification, the Fifth Modification, the Sixth Modification and the Seventh Modification, collectively, the “Amended Riverside South Declaration"). WHEREAS, the Riverside South Special Permits and the Amended Riverside South Declaration (collectively, the “Riverside South Approvals") impose certain requirements relating to the development of Parcel K. WHEREAS, pursuant to the Riverside South Approvals, Parcel K and the parcel designated as Parcel J ("Parcel J") in the Riverside South GLSD have been designated a single “zoning lot” (the "ZoningLot"). WHEREAS, pursuant to that certain Zoning Lot and Large Scale Development Agreement dated as of November 21, 2006 (*J/K LSDA") and recorded in the Office of the City Register on January 26, 2007 under CRFN Number 2007000048532, Parcel K-1 Owner and CRP/Extell Parcel J, L.P., the owner ("Parcel J Owner") of Parcel J allocated “floor area", “dwelling units" and parking spaces with respect to the Zoning Lot. WHEREAS, the J/K LSDA was amended by that certain Amendment to Zoning Lot and Large Scale Development Agreement ("First J/K LSDA Amendment") between Parcel K-1 Owner and CRP/RAR III Parcel J, L.P. dated as of June 11, 2008 and recorded in the Office of the City Register on August 22, 2008 under CRFN number 20008000336143. 207/24/20156:00PM NY245323866v2
